target: हमारे घर में बारह लोग एक साथ रहते हैं।
english: Twelve people live together in our house.
reason: Officialese/textbook register — 'संयुक्त परिवार में बारह सदस्य' reads like a civics lesson; nobody counts family in 'सदस्य' when speaking.

target: सातवीं कक्षा के बच्चों ने कल नाटक किया।
english: The seventh-grade children did a play yesterday.
reason: 'नाटक प्रस्तुत किया' is formal school-notice register; everyday speech is simply 'नाटक किया'.

target: मैं रोज़ अपना ज़रूरी काम सुबह ही पूरा कर लेता हूँ।
english: I finish my important work in the morning itself every day.
reason: Textbook-motto / self-congratulatory padding ('always, without delay'); replaced with an ordinary daily-routine statement using the same अपना + adjective pattern.

target: मेरे भाई ने दौड़ में पहला इनाम जीता।
english: My brother won first prize in the race.
reason: Sports-news trivia with the bookish word धावक; a learner will never say it. Same ने-past structure, everyday content.

target: देर होने पर मुझे फ़ोन कर देना।
english: If you get late, give me a call.
reason: Reads like a road-safety sign rather than speech; keeps the '…होने पर' construction in a sentence people actually say.

target: दो सौ लोगों ने शादी में खाना खाया।
english: Two hundred people ate at the wedding.
reason: Press-release register ('कार्यक्रम में भाग लिया', ten thousand people); replaced with an everyday large-number sentence keeping the ने-past.

target: यह कमरा दस फ़ीट लंबा और आठ फ़ीट चौड़ा है।
english: This room is ten feet long and eight feet wide.
reason: A sixty-foot-high wall is pointless trivia; room dimensions teach the same measurement pattern and are genuinely useful.

target: वह अक्सर अपनी छोटी बहन के यहाँ जाती है।
english: She often goes to her younger sister's place.
reason: 'अपनी प्यारी चाची' is sappy padding no one says out loud; same अपना + adjective + के यहाँ structure with a natural adjective.
